Peak Performance PT Boulder is a patient-centered physical therapy clinic located at 789 Pearl St, Boulder, CO 80302. Founded and led by Dr. Sarah Mitchell, DPT, who has 15 years of specialized experience treating athletes and active adults. The clinic specializes in sports rehabilitation, post-surgical recovery, and chronic pain management. They use evidence-based treatments including manual therapy, dry needling, and comprehensive movement analysis to help patients return to peak performance. Their approach focuses on addressing root causes rather than just symptoms, with personalized treatment plans for each patient. The clinic serves Boulder's active community, including athletes of all levels, weekend warriors, and active adults. They are open Monday-Friday 7am-6pm and Saturday 8am-12pm. Contact information includes phone (303) 555-7890 and email hello@peakpt.nephew.app. What sets them apart is their combination of Dr. Mitchell's extensive experience, evidence-based treatment methods, and deep understanding of the unique needs of Boulder's active population.
